data.one_liner: Cross-platform NTP and SNTP time synchronization client for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Synchronizes true UTC and local time via UDP and Web HTTP with microsecond precision, offset caching, and system clock tamper detection. It handles cross-platform discrepancies and unstable networks to deliver reliable, tamper-proof time.
use_when: You need accurate time that cannot be spoofed by users changing their device clock.
Your Flutter app targets Web/WASM as well as mobile and desktop platforms.
You need live accurate time streams or anti-tamper detection for financial, auction, or gaming apps.
avoid_when: Standard device DateTime.now() is completely sufficient for your app's requirements.
Your app has strictly zero network connectivity and never connects to the internet.
strengths: Cross-platform support including Web/WASM without intl dependency conflicts.
Includes built-in offset caching, multi-server failover, and multi-sample RTT filtering.
Provides reactive clock streams and system clock tamper detection.
weaknesses: Requires an active internet connection or a previously cached offset for initial accuracy.
Depends on external NTP servers or custom time API endpoints being reachable.
